jobs.title: Network Fulfilment Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Overview

Imagine
. With over 1,400 stores throughout the U.S. and a thriving supply chain network, there has never been a greater need for people of high initiative, of big-picture thinking, and adaptability to share in our journey. At Ulta Beauty, we have greater ambitions
. Growing what works. Iterating in areas that have promise. Creating new offerings for industry advantage.

In all of this is the opportunity to experience real impact, to effectuate change, to give wings to a spirit of creativity and entrepreneurism. Because the challenges are multi-faceted and ever-changing. But for those inspired by real-world demands that press and stretch, that call for new and smarter ideas, that require heavy doses of trust and respect, Ulta Beauty encourages you to imagine with us.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN HAVE:

As a Network Fulfillment Data Scientist, you will play a pivotal role in delivering possibilities in every direction by harnessing the power of data to optimize fulfillment across our enterprise. You will transform complex data into actionable insights, predictive capabilities, and prescriptive recommendations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify high-value business opportunities and develop advanced analytical solutions that enable better strategic and operational decision-making. Your insights will drive strategic decisions, enhance operational efficiency, and empower us to exceed guest expectations.

You will do this by utilizing advanced modeling techniques and optimization algorithms to design and evaluate various omnichannel fulfillment scenarios, considering factors such as, but not limited to fulfillment costs, transportation costs, inventory, transit times, and demand patterns with the goal of delivering an excellent guest experience while balancing operating cost and efficiency.

YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Operational Optimization

Develop order sourcing models to determine when to source from different fulfillment nodes using different carriers to maximize bottom line & speed to guest while protecting the guest experience.
Analyze allocations and order flows to recommend potential changes to sourcing logic to achieve expected business results.
Use Predictive modeling to support proactive action to drive benefits to our business.
Utilize software that has the capability to simulate scenarios to optimize use of the omnichannel fulfillment network.

Data Analysis and Insights:

Gather data and use appropriate analytical methods, mathematical models, and tools such as, but not limited to SQL, Python, Power BI, and Tableau to develop flexible, scalable fulfillment network models/what-if scenarios to understand, predict and improve network fulfillment, flows and processes.
Explain and present complex approaches in a concise manner to garner buy in from business partners.

Performance Metrics and Monitoring

Own the development and maintenance of ongoing metrics, models, analyses, and dashboards in connection with the Network Fulfillment team.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis, create reporting and metrics for Network Fulfillment
Demonstrate a high degree of originality and creativity when developing solutions to improve existing business processes within network fulfillment, utilizing methods such as predictive modeling, statistical analysis, regression modeling, and optimization.
Work with internal partners to assess business needs and transform them into meaningful outcomes by selecting optimal analytic technique(s) depending on the nature of the business problem.
Ensure data integrity by leveraging proven methodologies, including data reconciliation, data integration and data audits.
Work as a liaison among stakeholders to elicit, analyze, communicate, and validate requirements for changes to Network Fulfillment programs.
Determine continuous improvement opportunities and support projects to allow the organization to make trade-off decisions quickly with data.
Develop reporting tools, data sets, and visualizations to inform stakeholders on the Omnichannel business health.

THE ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in related discipline preferred (e.g. Supply Chain, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering)
Experience in retail and eCommerce industries
Experience with Supply Chain processes
3-5 years of professional experience in analytical functions
Knowledge of OMS/DOM and exposure to retail domains with focus on Order Management and Fulfillment Optimization modules (e.g., IBM Sterling, Manhattan DOM, etc.)
Experience using statistical computer languages (e.g., Python, R) and related frameworks to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
Experience with SQL and related data access and analysis tools to mine data, identify insights, and extract features.
Energetic and self-motivated with a strong sense of curiosity - must be extremely organized and detail oriented with an ability to make proactive recommendations.
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate complex ideas to various audiences in both a technical and user-friendly language.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively both in a team environment and independently by handling multiple projects, meeting deadlines, prioritizing appropriately, and responding to issues quickly and creatively with an open and positive attitude.

The pay range for this position is $90,800.00 - $126,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Staff Product Analyst (Workday Payroll, Absence & Time Tracking)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Enterprise Technology Team

The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Finance, Operations, and Security to bring data-driven, secure, compliant, and innovative solutions to life. 
The Staff Product Analyst Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Staff Product Analyst (Workday Payroll, Absence & Time Tracking) to join our People Technology Team. This is a pivotal role dedicated to the functional optimization of Okta's global Workday platform across Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking. You will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of these programs, from strategic discovery and design to global deployment and adoption. You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across People, Payroll, IT, and Finance, ensuring our People Technology suite drives automation, accuracy, and efficiency. If you are passionate about improving the employee experience through thoughtful Workday design, you'll fit right in.
What you’ll be doing 

Product Strategy and Roadmap:
Collaborate on the product vision and multi-year roadmap for Workday Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking, ensuring alignment with global People Technology and Finance team objectives.
Stakeholder Partnership:
Act as a strategic partner to People, Payroll, and Finance leadership, translating complex business needs into clear functional requirements and configuration designs.
Functional Configuration and Design:
Lead the design and configuration of Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking business processes, calculations, eligibility rules, and pay components that prioritize employee experience and operational efficiency.
Lifecycle Management:
Manage the full lifecycle of payroll, absence, and time tracking configuration, from initial discovery and requirements gathering through testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
Data-Driven Insights:
Leverage Workday reporting and analytics to monitor process performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable recommendations for payroll, absence, and time tracking optimization.
Vendor and Platform Management:
Oversee relationships with third-party vendors (e.g., ADP) to ensure seamless data flows and adherence to service level agreements.
Operational Excellence:
Champion continuous improvement by analyzing process and configuration issues, leading testing efforts, and proposing changes that enhance accuracy and reduce manual intervention.
Feature Adoption and Training:
Drive end-user adoption of new Workday features through comprehensive documentation, user guides, and training programs.
Compliance and Security:
Ensure all payroll, absence, and time tracking configurations strictly adhere to global data privacy requirements and internal security standards.

What you’ll bring to the role

Workday Expertise:
7+ years configuring Workday Payroll, Absence, and/or Time Tracking, including business process design, calculated fields, and eligibility rules.
Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking Domain Knowledge:
Deep functional expertise in Workday Payroll (GL, pay components, taxes), Absence, and Time Tracking configuration, along with global HR business processes.
Testing and Quality:
Proven experience leading tenant configuration testing, including UAT and regression testing, to ensure accurate, reliable releases.
Analytical Skills:
Advanced capability in building custom reports, dashboards, and hubs to drive data-informed decision-making.
Strategic Communication:
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
Problem Solving:
Superior ability to troubleshoot complex functional issues and design scalable configuration solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Agile Methodology:
Experience working in an Agile environment, managing backlogs, and delivering value through iterative cycles.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following! 

Experience with Workday integrations especially the Global Payroll Connect.
Workday Extend experience.
Workday Certification in Payroll, Absence, or Time Tracking.

Additional requirements:

U.S. soil status - the employee must be on U.S. soil, which means the 50 states, the District of Columbia, or outlying areas of the United States, as defined in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, and be a U.S. person.
U.S. person status - the employee must be either a U.S. citizen as defined in 42 U.S. Code § 9102; a natural person who is a lawful permanent resident as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or who is a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3); or a U.S. national (i.e. includes citizens and non-citizens born in outlying possessions such as American Samoa and Swains Island), green card holders, refugees, and asylees. Working on a U.S. visa does NOT qualify as a U.S. person.
